summary: Only 8 m of kerb at a junction, signed No Stopping Any Time.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 14 m and 17 m away on the west side, more within 30 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is 8 m long beside a junction mouth, too short for a van; cars at the kerb sit tight against the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy bend of Ryans Road at a junction.
drivers.convention: Two No Stopping Any Time signs sit at this kerb; a few cars appear parked there regardless.

sun_shade: Mixed; trees on the west side shade the southern end.
